fibre_desc.Fibre server guide: Step-by-step guide covering installation, node connection configuration, public address registration, cheat sheet, update and delete. Covers running Fibre on the validator server or on a separate one (private WireGuard tunnel + mTLS).
fibre_desc.Fibre Explorer (testnet): Registered Fibre providers and server readiness, multi-region host reachability checks, blob activity and a public API. Beta.

tools_desc.Decentralization Analytics: Analytics view to explore node/validator distribution and decentralization signals.
tools_desc.Governance Bot: Telegram bot to track governance proposals and receive status/timer notifications.
tools_desc.Peer scanner: Peer uptime and connectivity checker to validate p2p reachability in real time.
tools_desc.RPC Scanner: Public RPC scan results to compare endpoint availability and responsiveness.
tools_desc.consensus-signal-tracker: Consensus signal dashboard to observe consensus health trends and anomalies.

tools_desc.State-sync: State sync guide and endpoints to speed up node synchronization without downloading full history.
tools_desc.Public RPC: Public RPC endpoints and connection details for Celestia (useful for wallets, relayers, and tooling).

fibre_desc.Fibre Dashboard (testnet): NodeStake explorer view of the Fibre providers on Mocha.
fibre_desc.Celestia Testnet Tracker Bot (Telegram): Telegram bot for Celestia testnet: wallet, IBC and staking activity, validator missed signatures and profile changes, bridge node telemetry, and Fibre registrations, endpoint changes, outages and recovery.
fibre_desc.Celestia Fibre explained: NodeStake article explaining what Celestia Fibre is and how it works.

tools_desc.Validator missed proposals: Missed-proposals dashboard: live proposer chart, miss-rate rankings, daily heatmap and CSV export, plus a Proposer success-rate column (last 10,000 blocks) on the validator list.
tools_desc.Bridge Nodes explorer: Explorer view focused on Celestia bridge nodes and their operational state.

snapshot_check.note: Automated verification disabled; assumed available. Snapshot page is JS-rendered (Next.js) and blocks plain HTTP scraping/HEAD checks, same as Krews on mainnet.

fibre_desc.Fibre Dashboard: Real-time Fibre data: settled blobs, signatures, held data, providers, publishers and namespaces, plus a provider map (geo, latency/throughput and retention views). Each validator profile has a Fibre tab with signed settlements, serving checks and reach from 6 regions.

snapshot_check.note: Daily snapshot, filename embeds the block height (celestia-<height>.tar.lz4) and the page is static with no API or directory listing, so automated verification is disabled; last manually verified 2026-09-25 (file served 200, 38.7 GB, mocha-5).

fibre_desc.Celestia Hub - Fibre: Fibre section of NODERS' Celestia Hub explorer.
fibre_desc.Celestia Hub - Fibre Blobs: Browse Fibre blobs in the Celestia Hub explorer.
fibre_desc.Fibre Stats API (testnet): Public JSON endpoint with Fibre network statistics from NODERS' testnet Fibre indexer.

fibre_desc.Mocha Workbench: Stakeus workbench for Celestia Mocha: network tools and live data.
fibre_desc.Stakeus Atlas: Atlas view of Celestia Mocha nodes and infrastructure.
fibre_desc.Fibre Status API: Public status endpoint (with /api/v1/analytics) exposing Mocha network data.

tools_desc.Validator Platform: Celestia (Mainnet and Mocha) validator tracking: daily block participation vs. network median, missed proposals marked on the chart, and shareable network and validator reports.

fibre_desc.Fibre Reachability Checks: Shows whether a validator's Fibre host answers checks from outside the network, on Mainnet and Mocha.
fibre_desc.Fibre Server Templates: Open-source configuration templates to deploy a Celestia Fibre server.
fibre_desc.Validator and Fibre Monitoring: Open-source monitoring setup for Celestia validators and Fibre servers.

fibre_desc.Fibre Operations Lab: Operator tooling for Celestia Fibre from BlackNodes.
fibre_desc.Fibre Status API: Public JSON endpoint with Fibre network status.
fibre_desc.Fibre Analytics API: Public JSON endpoint with Fibre network analytics.

tools_desc.Mocha-5 genesis.json: Genesis file for the Mocha-5 testnet.
tools_desc.Mocha-5 SHA256 checksums: SHA256 checksums to verify the Mocha-5 files.
tools_desc.OneClickNodeCelestia: Open-source script to deploy a Celestia node in one step.

fibre_desc.Fibre validator explorer: Tracks the full Mocha-5 validator set and Fibre rollout in real time: host registration and stake readiness, provider reachability/latency/24h uptime, validator endorsements and missed blobs, blobs/namespaces/data throughput, escrow balances/deposits/withdrawals/payers, and server locations/hosting providers.

fibre_desc.Tensile - Fibre retention verification: Independent, outside verification that validators keep serving the Fibre shards they signed for across the full retention window: per-endpoint DNS/TCP/TLS/consensus-key checks every 5 min with exact error and fix, ⅔-stake readiness tracking, service rate and per-obligation results once blobs flow, ed25519-signed daily exports, dispute route, and public methodology/API.

fibre_desc.Tenderduty fork v2.3.0: Refactored Tenderduty fork to monitor validators, Fibre and bridge nodes in one place: Fibre registration, reachability, signing, storage and endorsements; bridge node downtime and sync lag; upgrade signals; Telegram, Discord, Slack, PagerDuty and Gotify alerts; Prometheus metrics.

fibre_desc.Macro Data on Fibre: Live beta publishing TradingEconomics macro indicators (gold, silver, copper and more) as blobs on Celestia Fibre (mocha-5): Band Protocol fetches the data, an XRPL EVM transaction relays it, and the payload is posted as a blob. Each step can be opened and verified independently.

fibre_desc.CelestiaResource Fibre: Search registered Fibre providers on Mocha by validator name or address (operator/consensus addresses, registered hosts), with links to official Fibre docs, monitoring guide and intro post. Includes an Advanced section to import and inspect a Prometheus metrics snapshot locally. Shows on-chain registrations only - does not yet check live server availability or blob endorsements.

fibre_desc.Fibre Map: Interactive map of Celestia Fibre nodes and providers on Mocha testnet (locations, hosting providers, decentralization view).

tools_desc.Labs state.sh (one-command snapshot): Verified Celestia state republished every ~4.5 min (app_hash checked against a quorum of independent public RPCs, no signing state included). One command: curl -sSL https://labs.mammoblocks.io/state.sh | bash -s -- --network mocha-5

tools_desc.R1M Sentinel: Multi-network validator alert platform. Sends instant Telegram notifications about validator node status to help maintain high uptime. Supports Celestia testnet and mainnet validators.
tools_desc.R1M Community App: Community hub for Celestia: ecosystem, market data, token unlocks and vesting, articles and team info, plus a Network section with staking, Signal Tracker, Consensus Monitor and Decentralization Map.

fibre_desc.R1M Sentinel (Fibre alerts): Alert system for Fibre servers on testnet: instant Telegram notifications to help keep Fibre uptime high. Mainnet support will be added once Fibre launches there.
fibre_desc.R1M Fibre dashboard: Fibre and Providers pages inside the R1M Community App for Celestia.

fibre_desc.Moving Fibre off the validator host (pri: Operator write-up on running Fibre on a separate server from the validator: sizing the machine (CPU flags, memory, storage and traffic), private VLAN vs WireGuard, mTLS on the signing channel, the cutover order and valaddr host registration. Also covers moving the validator from Warsaw to Singapore and the latency trade-offs.

tools_desc.Celestia Block Explorer: Real-time multi-section block explorer covering validator uptime, governance proposals, live consensus state, recent transactions, and network statistics.
tools_desc.Cumulo Live Peers: A live peer checker, updated every 30 minutes and available through both a public dashboard and API.
tools_desc.CIP Tracker: The CIP Tracker is designed to make it easier for teams, devs, validators and the broader community to follow how Celestia evolves at the protocol level: from proposals already live on mainnet to those currently under review or being discussed for upcoming upgrades.
tools_desc.Missed Proposals Tracker: Block-level tracking of missed proposal slots using the CometBFT weighted round-robin simulation. Identifies which validator missed their turn at each consensus round, with cumulative per-validator statistics and miss rate.
tools_desc.Dashboard in Grafana: Grafana dashboard reference for node monitoring (service health and performance signals).

fibre_desc.Fibre Dashboard: Interactive dashboard with network readiness vs the 2/3 stake threshold, per-validator performance pages, regional latency, signatures, verified blob retention, infrastructure concentration and Fibre economics. Includes weekly, monthly and yearly reports and the measurement methodology.
fibre_desc.Fibre Network API: Public read-only API (no key, CORS, OpenAPI 3.1, updated every minute) with Fibre network status, validator performance, signatures, blob retention checks, blobs and fees, plus Prometheus metrics and live SVG badges. Docs, examples and integration guides.
fibre_desc.Fibre Grafana Dashboards: Public read-only Grafana dashboards (no login) for Celestia Fibre, mainnet and Mocha side by side, refreshed every minute from the public Fibre API: Home, Readiness & Quorum, Decentralization, Latency, Validators, Signatures & DA, Market, Protocol & Monitor and Cumulo validator.
fibre_desc.My Validator Fibre Dashboard: Importable Grafana dashboard with the per-validator Fibre view (readiness, probe regions, round trip, uptime, signing, data kept, certificate and warnings) for your own validator. Prometheus version (one scrape job, native alerts) or Infinity plugin version (reads the API directly, 7 and 30 days of history). Open source (MIT) with setup steps.
fibre_desc.Fibre Telegram Bot: Telegram bot with Fibre network, validator and weekly report cards (/fibre, /status <validator>, /card).
